transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining the final preflight review for the Mara Chen retrospective catalog. As you know, final production approval is scheduled for Friday afternoon, so I want to make sure we've covered all bases before I sign off on the package. The current draft includes the print catalog, a downloadable digital edition, several archival photographs, and a sponsor acknowledgment. I'd like to go around the room — archive, rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads — to get your sign-offs or flag any issues. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue. This morning I found the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive in the archive file. It places two hard constraints on us: first, the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog; second, the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. I haven't yet updated the production brief, so the current draft likely doesn't reflect either restriction. We need to verify our planned print run against the 300-copy limit, and the digital edition will need the archival photographs removed before we can proceed to approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. Yesterday I confirmed by email that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos,' and that the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. I haven't entered this confirmation in the rights register yet, so the current draft likely still has that image on the cover and may not have the correct credit line.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two accessibility requirements from my test. First, the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF. Second, every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. I should note that my test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist, so these requirements may not yet be reflected in the current draft.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team, so the current draft likely doesn't reflect these requirements.
transcript.speaker: A5
